project.name: Pathland Core
project.description: The Pathland JVM opcode/wire core, written in pure Java 17: the 16-byte opcode protocol, the self-contained PLPL frame codec, the opcode sink surface, raw input events, environment data, the attributed-text model, and the pure-Java inline-Markdown parser. No Kotlin source and no native dependency, so it runs on every platform and under GraalVM native-image.
